schedule.description: The Discord channel ID of the schedule channel for this template

events.description: The Discord channel ID of the events channel for this template

introduction.description: The Discord channel ID of the introductions channel for this template

general.description: The Discord channel ID of the general (normal chat) channel for this template

forum.description: The Discord channel ID of the forum channel for this template

default_timezone.description: The default timezone to use for this template in IANA (Region/Zone) format.

use_all_events.description: Whether this schedule encompasses all the event lanes or not.

abbreviation.description: How this language is abbreviated e.g. ASL

native_localization.description: The ISO code of the language considered the 'native written language' associated with this template, e.g. en

channel.description: The key in the 'channels' object that this corresponds to.

url.description: The name of the environment variable containing the webhook URL to use.

message_id.description: The name of the environment variable containing the ID of the message to update.

header.description: Content to appear in the 'header embed' if applicable

display_timezones.description: Timezones spelled out explicitly underneath each dynamic timestamp, in display order. Omit to keep the server-wide default set.

flag.description: A two letter region code (converted to a flag emoji) or a literal emoji such as 🌐.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Seoul. The literal 'UTC' is also accepted.

label.description: Override for the abbreviation. Omit to let the zone decide, which correctly alternates PST/PDT, CET/CEST and so on.

localization.description: Bilingual (한/영) layout settings for this lane's embeds.

secondary.description: Language shown second. Omit for a single-language lane.

separator.description: Placed between the two languages on a shared line. Defaults to ' · '.

labels.description: Overrides for the embed's own wording (host, level, join, no_events, recharge, ...).

additionalProperties.description: Text carried in several languages, keyed by ISO 639-1 code (ko, en, ...).

levels.description: The classes this lane teaches, keyed by the id used in events.yaml. For KSL these are 씨앗반 / 별빛반 / 달빛반.

emoji.description: Icon shown before the class name, e.g. 🌱 ⭐ 🌙.

names.description: The class name in each language, e.g. '씨앗반 - 입문'. Rendered inside brackets.

order.description: Sort hint, lowest is the most introductory.

vrchat.description: Lane-wide VRChat defaults. Individual events may override any of these.

group.description: Display name of the VRChat group, e.g. KSL.

group_url.description: Link to the VRChat group page.

instance_url.description: Direct world instance invite link, e.g. https://vrchat.com/i/...

discord_events.description: Mirrors Discord Scheduled Events from a guild into this lane's schedule. Requires the bot (scripts/bot/).

guild.description: The Discord guild ID to read scheduled events from.

name_prefix.description: Only mirror events whose name starts with this. Omit to mirror all of them.

default_kind.description: Kind applied to mirrored events. Defaults to 'event'.

interactions.description: Attach RSVP / reminder buttons to this lane's schedule. Requires the bot (scripts/bot/) - the GitHub Actions webhook build cannot send interactive buttons.

roles.description: The official host titles for this lane, keyed by the id used in events.yaml. Defining them here means renaming a title is one edit rather than one per class.

emoji.description: Icon shown before the title, e.g. 👑 🏫 🎗️.

names.description: The title in each language, e.g. '담임선생님'.
